expanded.G1-01: [CONFIRMED|HIGH|source_and_reproduced] speech-front/src/normalize.rs:460-464 — speech-front skips unit expansion (млн, кг, км, тыс.) on decimal numbers due to `!decimal` guard. Invariant: Decimal quantities with known Russian unit abbreviations must expand and decline the unit into genitive singular. Evidence: Verified in speech-front/src/normalize.rs:460 (`if !decimal`) vs teratts-server/src/speechfront.rs:544 (`decimal_with_suffix`), and reproduced via CLI (`2.5 млн` -> `две целых пять десятых млн`). Counterevidence: Percentage (`%`) on decimals is handled separately at line 453; integer units work normally.
expanded.G1-02: [CONFIRMED|HIGH|source_and_reproduced] speech-front/src/normalize.rs:214-221 — speech-front lacks `parse_iso_date`, corrupting YYYY-MM-DD dates into hyphenated numeric ranges plus `-DD`. Invariant: ISO-8601 dates must normalize as calendar dates (or preserve ISO datetimes), never split into ranges. Evidence: Verified in speech-front/src/normalize.rs:214-221 (missing `parse_iso_date`) vs teratts-server/src/speechfront.rs:373-445, and reproduced via CLI (`2026-08-12` -> `две тысячи двадцать шесть — восемь-двенадцать`). Counterevidence: Dot/slash numeric dates (`DD.MM.YYYY`) are handled by `parse_numeric_date`.
expanded.G1-06: [CONFIRMED|HIGH|source_and_reproduced] speech-front/src/normalize.rs:183-196 — speech-front `boundaries_match` permits non-identifier-prefixed entries like `/v1/chat/completions` to match immediately after domain names (`example.com/v1/chat/completions`). Invariant: Lexicon entries starting with `/` must not match when immediately preceded by an identifier character. Evidence: Verified at speech-front/src/normalize.rs:194 (`!first.is_some_and(is_identifier_char)` is true for `'/'`, bypassing `!previous.is_some_and(...)`) and reproduced via CLI (`https://example.comви один, чат комплишнс`). Counterevidence: teratts-server/src/speechfront.rs:199 already fixed this by requiring `!previous.is_some_and(is_identifier_char)`.
expanded.G2-02: [CONFIRMED|HIGH|source_proven] teratts-server/src/russian_only.rs:302-317 — `teratts-server` `normalize_symbols` replaces precomposed Latin letters with diacritics, ligatures, and fullwidth Latin (`café`, `ﬂow`, `ＡＰＩ`) with spaces before calling `speech-front`. Invariant: Latin characters supported by `speech-front`'s `latin(c)` NFKD deaccenting contract must not be stripped into spaces by `teratts-server`. Evidence: Verified at teratts-server/src/russian_only.rs:303,335: only `c.is_ascii_alphabetic()` is permitted for Latin, whereas speech-front/src/russian_only.rs:348-352 supports `0x00C0..=0x024F` (except `×,÷,ß,ø`), `0x1E00..=0x1EFF`, `0xFB00..=0xFB06`, `0xFF21..=0xFF5A`. Thus `café` becomes `caf ` instead of `кафе`/`кэйф`. Counterevidence: Commit d273224 intended to replace unsupported CJK/emoji with spaces, but inadvertently excluded non-ASCII Latin ranges supported by `speech-front`.
expanded.G3-07: [CONFIRMED|HIGH|source_proven] teratts-server/src/speechfront.rs:1-1166 — 1,166 lines of normalization logic in `teratts-server/src/speechfront.rs` duplicate `speech-front/src/normalize.rs` (1,003 LOC), directly causing the 6 behavioral drift bugs found in G1-01..G1-07. Invariant: Shared normalization logic should be maintained in one authoritative source or synchronized mechanically. Evidence: Verified via `check-4-cross-repo-diff.txt` (646-line diff between the two copies) and the resulting drift bugs G1-01..G1-07. Counterevidence: The two repositories have different licenses (`speech-front` vs GPL-3.0 `teratts-server`, noted in `docs/speech-front-integration.md:82-83`), which originally motivated vendoring.

Invariant: ISO-8601 dates must normalize as dates, not numeric ranges. Evidence: Verified and reproduced in check-5; exact root-cause duplicate of G1-02. Counterevidence: Fixed in `teratts-server/src/speechfront.rs:373-422`.

Invariant: Decimal numbers with unit abbreviations must expand and decline the unit. Evidence: Verified and reproduced in check-5; exact root-cause duplicate of G1-01. text:
=== System & Scope Summary ===
Target: speech-front (standalone Rust speech front-end and CMUDict phonetic engine, commit 2cce5ebf) and its teratts-server integration modules (`src/speechfront.rs`, `src/russian_only.rs`, `src/lexicon_reload.rs`, commit 715a117e).
Mechanical Checks: All 68 unit tests + clippy in speech-front passed; all 31 speech-front/russian_only/lexicon_reload unit tests plus both cross-project integration tests (`cross_project_approve_reloads`, `installed_converter_cross_project`) passed on linux-worker.

=== Confirmed Findings Inventory (43 confirmed: 5 HIGH, 11 MEDIUM, 27 LOW; 7 duplicates; 7 rejected) ===
- G1-01 [HIGH|source_and_reproduced] sf/normalize.rs:460-464: speech-front skips unit expansion (млн, кг, км, тыс.) on decimal numbers due to `!decimal` guard.
- G1-02 [HIGH|source_and_reproduced] sf/normalize.rs:214-221: speech-front lacks `parse_iso_date`, corrupting YYYY-MM-DD dates into hyphenated numeric ranges plus `-DD`.
- G1-03 [MEDIUM|source_and_reproduced] sf/normalize.rs:441-446: speech-front expands leading numbers of hyphenated technical identifiers (`64-bit`, `12-factor`, `7-zip`).
- G1-04 [MEDIUM|source_and_reproduced] sf/normalize.rs:255-266: speech-front `parse_version` omits `attached_to_identifier`, rewriting `node-v22.23.2` into `node-вэ двадцать два...`.
- G1-05 [LOW|source_proven] ts/speechfront.rs:195-201: teratts-server `boundaries_match` dropped the leading-dot guard (`first == Some('.')`), allowing `.NET` to match after `/` or `-` if added to lexicon.
- G1-06 [HIGH|source_and_reproduced] sf/normalize.rs:183-196: speech-front `boundaries_match` permits non-identifier-prefixed entries like `/v1/chat/completions` to match immediately after domain names (`example.com/v1/chat/completions`).
- G1-07 [MEDIUM|source_proven] sf/normalize.rs:159-172: speech-front `longest_match` allocates two `String`s (`to_lowercase()`) and recounts chars per entry per char position.
- G1-08 [MEDIUM|source_proven] ts/lexicon_reload.rs:53-66: `LexiconReload::refresh` holds `self.state.lock()` while reading up to 2 MiB from disk, computing SHA-256, and parsing TOML.
- G1-10 [LOW|source_proven] ts/lexicon_reload.rs:57-66: When an external lexicon file is corrupted, `LexiconReload::refresh` re-reads, re-hashes, and re-parses the broken TOML on every enabled request.
- G1-11 [MEDIUM|source_and_reproduced] ts/speechfront.rs:354-371: `parse_numeric_date` and `parse_iso_date` do not consume trailing `года`/`год`/`г.`, producing duplicate `года года` or `года г.`.
- G1-12 [LOW|source_and_reproduced] ts/speechfront.rs:481-491: Numeric range branch in `parse_number` only expands `%` suffixes and leaves standard unit suffixes (`10-20 км`) unexpanded.
- G2-01 [MEDIUM|source_proven] ts/russian_only.rs:408-428: `teratts-server` `flatten_tags` converts non-2-letter angle-bracket tags (`<b>`, `<div>`, `<path>`) into spoken words (`div`, `path`), whereas `speech-front` rejects all unknown `<tag>` markup.
- G2-02 [HIGH|source_proven] ts/russian_only.rs:302-317: `teratts-server` `normalize_symbols` replaces precomposed Latin letters with diacritics, ligatures, and fullwidth Latin (`café`, `ﬂow`, `ＡＰＩ`) with spaces before calling `speech-front`.
- G2-03 [LOW|source_proven] ts/russian_only.rs:194-204: `speech-front` prints up to `MAX_SERIALIZED_BYTES` (262,144) with `println!` (+1 byte `\n`), which exceeds `teratts-server`'s `MAX_JSON_BYTES` (262,144) by 1 byte at the exact boundary.
- G2-04 [LOW|source_and_reproduced] sf/main.rs:114-121: `speech-front russian-only` CLI pre-strips `<ru>/<en>` tags at line 114 before `Converter::convert`, suppressing the `language_tags_removed` warning.
- G2-05 [MEDIUM|source_proven] ts/server.rs:904-913: `teratts-server` spawns the `speech-front` subprocess and opens SQLite `cmudict.db` on every `russian_only` request even when the text is already 100% valid Russian plaintext.
- G2-07 [LOW|source_proven] ts/russian_only.rs:232-235: When `speech-front` rejects input for `reading_limit_exceeded` (>1024 readings) or `output_limit_exceeded` (>12,000 chars), `teratts-server` maps the non-zero exit to `ConversionError::Failed` (HTTP 502) instead of `InvalidText` (HTTP 400).
- G2-08 [LOW|source_proven] sf/pronounce/render.rs:125-135: `split_term` in `render.rs` does not split same-case Cyrillic/Latin transitions (`ТЕСТAPI`), so `Generator::suggest` misses script boundaries that `russian_only.rs` pre-splits.
- G3-01 [LOW|source_proven] sf/normalize.rs:93-105: Ponytail ceiling breached: comment states `162 entries are tiny; use a sorted scan`, while `lexicon.toml` now has 186 entries.
- G3-03 [LOW|source_proven] sf/pronounce/mod.rs:152: Ponytail marker `// ponytail: bounded beam of three candidates per part, not a full Cartesian product.` lacks an explicit upgrade trigger (`no-trigger`).
- G3-04 [LOW|source_proven] ts/russian_only.rs:153: Ponytail marker `// ponytail: kill only this process; binaries spawning descendants are unsupported.` lacks an upgrade trigger (`no-trigger`).
- G3-05 [LOW|source_proven] sf/observe.rs:1-2137: `observe.rs` (2137 LOC, including 789 LOC of tests) combines SQLite persistence, Horizon TSV/JSON import, atomic lexicon locking, and text token classification.
- G3-06 [LOW|source_proven] sf/review.rs:343-442: `GitPublisher` (100 LOC) is embedded inside the Axum HTTP review module `review.rs` (1067 LOC).
- G3-07 [HIGH|source_proven] ts/speechfront.rs:1-1166: 1,166 lines of normalization logic in `teratts-server/src/speechfront.rs` duplicate `speech-front/src/normalize.rs` (1,003 LOC), directly causing the 6 behavioral drift bugs found in G1-01..G1-07.
- G3-08 [LOW|source_proven] sf/main.rs:70-94: `speech-front serve --tera-url` sets `RendererCommand` to re-invoke `speech-front render-tera` as a child process instead of calling `tera_client::render` in-process.
- G3-10 [MEDIUM|source_proven] sf/review.rs:269-285: Preview audio cache filenames use `{pid}-{sequence}.wav` (`review.rs:270`) while `RendererCommand::render` (`review.rs:319`) errors if the target file already exists; if a restarted server reuses the same PID (e.g. PID 1 in a container or recycled OS PID), preview fails with HTTP 502.
- G3-11 [LOW|source_proven] sf/observe.rs:488-510: `Store::approve` is marked `#[cfg(test)]` and only called by unit tests, while production uses `approve_with_context`.
- G3-12 [LOW|source_proven] sf/review.rs:723-764: `replace_candidate_with` allocates `to_lowercase()` at every char index and `preview()` checks candidate presence by replacing with `"\0"` and comparing strings.
- G3-13 [LOW|source_and_reproduced] sf/main.rs:363-460: Hand-rolled CLI parser requires subcommand before global flags (e.g. `speech-front --lexicon PATH normalize` fails with `unknown command: --lexicon`) and treats misplaced flags like `--text` as positional text.
- G3-14 [LOW|source_proven] sf/observe.rs:747-805: `candidates_by_kind` and `decisions` execute 4 secondary SQLite queries per row (N+1 query pattern).
- G3-15 [LOW|source_proven] sf/review.rs:765-776: `escape_attr` is a one-line wrapper identical to `escape_html`.
- O1-01 [MEDIUM|source_proven] sf/review.rs:131-196: `async fn decision` acquires a synchronous `std::sync::Mutex` (`state.decision_lock`) and holds it across synchronous SQLite I/O and `git commit` + `git push` subprocess execution on the Tokio worker thread.
- O1-02 [LOW|source_proven] sf/review.rs:98-104: Review server router relies on Axum's default 2 MiB form body limit rather than setting a tighter `DefaultBodyLimit` (e.g. 16 KiB) for small decision/preview forms.
- O1-03 [LOW|source_proven] ts/server.rs:472-473: `UnsupportedHtmlBlock` error response echoes the rejected HTML line inside JSON `{"error": "unsupported HTML block: ..."}`.
- O1-04 [LOW|source_proven] sf/main.rs:507-513: `read_text()` for CLI `normalize` and `observe` reads stdin via `read_to_string` without a `.take()` byte cap, unlike `russian-only` which caps stdin at 48,001 bytes (`main.rs:103`).
- O1-05 [LOW|source_proven] sf/ingest.rs:37-40: `ingest_text_path`, `ingest_conspects`, and `ingest_debriefs` call `fs::read_to_string` without checking file size metadata first.
- O1-06 [LOW|source_proven] ts/lexicon_reload.rs:119-136: `open_regular_file` checks `fs::metadata(path)` before `options.open(path)` without `O_NOFOLLOW`.
- O1-07 [LOW|source_proven] ts/russian_only.rs:218-244: `convert_with_deadline` polls child completion with `thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5))` instead of blocking on `rx.recv_timeout(...)`.
- O3-01 [MEDIUM|source_proven] sf/observe.rs:129-133: `Store::open` configures no SQLite `busy_timeout` (default 0 ms), so any concurrent access during an active write/migration transaction immediately fails with `SQLITE_BUSY`.
- O3-02 [MEDIUM|source_proven] sf/observe.rs:142-257: `Store::initialize()` starts a `TransactionBehavior::Immediate` write transaction on every `Store::open()`, including read-only `index()`, `preview()`, and `candidates` calls on an already-migrated v3 database.
- O3-03 [LOW|source_proven] sf/review.rs:183-196: `publisher.publish()` runs after `approve_with_context` drops the `.speech-front.lock` file lock, allowing a concurrent CLI `approve` to modify `lexicon.toml` before `git add -- lexicon.toml`.
- O3-06 [LOW|source_proven] sf/observe.rs:259-444: `record`, `replace_source`, and `import_horizon` use `DEFERRED` transactions, which combined with 0 ms `busy_timeout` (O3-01) can fail with `SQLITE_BUSY` on upgrade to write lock.
- O3-07 [LOW|source_proven] sf/review.rs:386-412: `GitPublisher::publish()` verifies the active Git branch only at server startup (`new()`), not before each `git commit`.

=== Key Architectural & Correctness Themes ===
1. Cross-Repo Normalization Drift (HIGH: G1-01, G1-02, G1-06, G3-07; MEDIUM: G1-03, G1-04, G1-07, G1-11): `teratts-server/src/speechfront.rs` (1,166 LOC) is a vendored fork of `speech-front/src/normalize.rs` (1,003 LOC). Fixes added to `teratts-server` (ISO-8601 dates `2026-08-12`, decimal units `2.5 млн`, hyphenated identifiers `64-bit`/`7-zip`, `node-v22.23.2` version guard, URL path boundary `/v1/chat/completions`, and zero-allocation `longest_match`) were never backported to `speech-front/src/normalize.rs`, and were reproduced failing on the live `speech-front` CLI in check-5. Conversely, `teratts-server` dropped the `.NET` leading-dot guard (G1-05), and both copies duplicate `года` on numeric/ISO dates followed by `года`/`г.` (`12.08.2026 года` -> `...года года`, G1-11).
2. Cross-Repo `russian-only` Contract Drift & Diacritic Bug (HIGH: G2-02; MEDIUM: G2-01, G2-05): In commit d273224, `teratts-server/src/russian_only.rs` (`normalize_symbols`) replaced unsupported CJK/emoji with spaces, but its allowlist (`plain_char(c) || c.is_ascii_alphabetic()`) omitted `speech-front`'s extended Latin ranges (`0x00C0..=0x024F`, ligatures, fullwidth Latin), turning `café` -> `caf ` and `ﬂow` -> ` ow` instead of passing them to `speech-front`'s NFKD deaccenting pipeline (G2-02). Similarly, commit 70d95e2 allowed `<placeholder>` tags in `teratts-server` `flatten_tags` by turning tag names into spoken words (including HTML `<div>` -> `div`), while `speech-front` rejects all unknown `<tag>` markup (G2-01).
3. Concurrency, Lock & SQLite Contention (MEDIUM: G1-08, G3-10, O1-01, O3-01, O3-02): `speech-front/src/observe.rs` sets no SQLite `busy_timeout` (O3-01) and runs an `IMMEDIATE` write transaction on every `Store::open()` even for read-only views (O3-02). `review.rs` holds a synchronous `std::sync::Mutex` across blocking SQLite and `git push` inside an `async fn` (O1-01) and uses `{pid}-{seq}.wav` cache names that collide if a container/OS reuses PIDs across restarts (G3-10). In `teratts-server`, `LexiconReload::refresh` holds its mutex across synchronous disk read + SHA-256 hashing on every enabled request (G1-08).

=== Evaluator Questions ===
1. Is the evidence sufficient (`sufficient`, `limited`, or `insufficient`) to assess the health, correctness, and security of `speech-front` and its `teratts-server` integration?
2. What is your overall recommendation (`proceed`, `remediate`, `validate_more`, or `hold`) and what concrete acceptance conditions should govern remediation?
3. Respond directly (without calling tools) with a structured evaluation containing: `sufficiency` (`sufficient`|`limited`|`insufficient`), `recommendation` (`proceed`|`remediate`|`validate_more`|`hold`), `limitations` (non-empty list of strings), `acceptance_conditions` (non-empty list of strings), and your architectural verdict.
